cmd: echo 'W1.10 warehouse target: MotherDuck Lite, prod output md:absump.' && grep -q "path: 'md:absump'" dbt/profiles.yml.example && grep -q "env_var('MOTHERDUCK_TOKEN'" dbt/profiles.yml.example && grep -q '^MOTHERDUCK_TOKEN=' .env.example && grep -q 'md:absump' docs/warehouse.md && if [ -z "${MOTHERDUCK_TOKEN:-}" ]; then echo 'W1.10 prod target: MOTHERDUCK_TOKEN is unset, so dbt debug --target prod and the duckdb attach of md:absump are skipped. A skip is a pass. The dev target needs no token.'; else { if [ -f dbt/dbt_project.yml ]; then uv run --locked dbt debug --project-dir dbt --target prod 2>&1 | tee /dev/stderr | grep 'Connection test: OK' >/dev/null; else echo 'W1.10 prod target: dbt/dbt_project.yml is absent, so the prod dbt debug is skipped here and runs under the SOP W1.11 gate.'; fi; } && duckdb -c "ATTACH 'md:absump'; SHOW DATABASES;" 2>&1 | tee /dev/stderr | grep absump >/dev/null; fi
title: Warehouse target, MotherDuck Lite
